## Global Payments Inc. - Senior Software Engineer – Java/Spring Boot, Monolith Systems Development and Modernization

🔗 [Apply](https://tsys.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/tsys/job/boston-massachusetts/senior-software-engineer---java-spring-boot-engineer--monolith-systems-development-and-modernization-_r0075528)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Java/Spring Boot engineer modernizing Global Payments’ payment-processing monolith and microservices. Designing scalable, reliable software for high-volume merchant transactions.
Senior Java/Spring Boot engineer modernizing payment-processing monoliths and microservices at Global Payments
- Salary: $87,500 - $139,250 per year
- Tech stack: Ansible, AWS, Gradle, Java, Jenkins, JUnit, Kafka, Kubernetes, Maven, Microservices, OpenShift, Prometheus, ServiceNow, Splunk, SQL
- Plan and manage application development and client delivery activities
- Design, develop, and test software for scalability, reliability, and data recovery on a high-volume, high-availability platform
- Contribute to a complex monolithic application powering payment processing and value-added services for merchants
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices while modernizing platforms
- Collaborate with Product, Platform, Merchant Services, and Support teams to convert business requirements into technical solutions
- Use Agile techniques including pair programming and test-driven development
- Deploy new features into production with zero platform downtime and no impact to customers processing transactions
- Build domain expertise in e-commerce payments and develop new product features
- This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future
- Must be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder
- Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, another related discipline, or equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience
- 7+ years of relevant job experience in Java Software Engineering, excluding internships
- Exceptional design, SQL, and Java programming skills
- Ability to grasp high-level business goals, derive requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
- Ability to change context and priorities based on changing business needs
- Proficiency with SQL, relational data modelling, and database schema design

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Java/Spring Boot engineer modernizing Global Payments’ payment-processing monolith and microservices. Designing scalable, reliable software for high-volume merchant transactions.
Senior Java/Spring Boot engineer modernizing payment-processing monoliths and microservices at Global Payments
Role description:
• Plan and manage application development and client delivery activities
• Design, develop, and test software for scalability, reliability, and data recovery on a high-volume, high-availability platform
• Contribute to a complex monolithic application powering payment processing and value-added services for merchants
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices while modernizing platforms
• Collaborate with Product, Platform, Merchant Services, and Support teams to convert business requirements into technical solutions
• Use Agile techniques including pair programming and test-driven development
• Deploy new features into production with zero platform downtime and no impact to customers processing transactions
• Build domain expertise in e-commerce payments and develop new product features
Role requirements:
• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future
• Must be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder
• Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, another related discipline, or equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience
• 7+ years of relevant job experience in Java Software Engineering, excluding internships
• Exceptional design, SQL, and Java programming skills
• Ability to grasp high-level business goals, derive requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
• Ability to change context and priorities based on changing business needs
• Proficiency with SQL, relational data modelling, and database schema design
• Pair programming willingness is a requirement
• Experience with Microservices architecture, globally distributed services, and 24/7 support is a bonus
• Experience with RESTful API design, Kubernetes, and Kafka is a bonus
• Experience with monitoring and responsive, self-healing resilient immutable platforms is a bonus
• Knowledge of scalability levers in high-volume, low-latency transactional systems is a bonus
• Experience with AWS and OpenShift Platform is a bonus
• Experience with Ansible, Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Harness, Snyk, SonarQ, Cucumber, and Karate is a bonus
• Experience with Splunk, Sysdig, OpsGenie, Open Telemetry, Instaclustr, Prometheus, JBehave, JGiven, Xmatters, and ServiceNow is a bonus
• Development experience with a unit testing framework, such as JUnit, is a bonus; TDD experience preferred
• Pair programming experience is a bonus
Benefits:
• Competitive compensation
• Remote work in the Greater Boston area or hybrid work in Alpharetta, GA
• Equal opportunity employment
• Reasonable accommodations during hiring and employment
• Drug testing for conditional offers in the United States
Tech stack:
Ansible, AWS, Gradle, Java, Jenkins, JUnit, Kafka, Kubernetes, Maven, Microservices, OpenShift, Prometheus, ServiceNow, Splunk, SQL
